arxiv-1708-06220.title: Models of compact stars on paraboloidal spacetime satisfying Karmarkar condition
arxiv-1708-06220.creator: D. M. Pandya, V. O. Thomas
arxiv-1708-06220.description: Abstract A new exact solution of Einstein’s field equations on the background of paraboloidal spacetime using Karmarkar condition is reported. The physical acceptability conditions of the model are investigated and found that the model is compatible with a number of compact star candidates like Her X-1, LMC X-4, EXO 1785-248, PSR J1903+327, Vela X-1 and PSR J1614-2230.

arxiv-2111-01893.title: The sup-norm problem beyond the newform
arxiv-2111-01893.creator: Edgar Assing
arxiv-2111-01893.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Edgar Assing. In this note we take up the classical sup-norm problem for automorphic forms and view it from a new angle. Given a twist minimal automorphic representation π \pi we consider a special small G ​ L 2 ​ ( ℤ p ) GL_{2}(\mathbb{Z}_{p}) -type V V in π \pi and prove global sup-norm bounds for an average over an orthonormal basis of V V . We achieve a non-trivial saving when the dimension of V V grows.

arxiv-2308-10356.title: Comparing measurements and limits on the warm dark matter temperature-to-mass ratio
arxiv-2308-10356.creator: Bruce Hoeneisen
arxiv-2308-10356.description: Abstract Limits on the “thermal relic” warm dark matter mass are apparently inconsistent with measurements of the warm dark matter temperature-to-mass ratio. We try to understand this problem. 1 Introduction Limits on the “thermal relic” warm dark matter mass have been obtained from the Lyman- \alpha flux power spectrum of quasars and hydro-dynamical simulations.

arxiv-2311-15047.description: Abstract On dedicated analog hardware, equilibrium propagation is an energy-efficient alternative to backpropagation. Meanwhile, despite its high computational demands, generative AI is on the rise.

arxiv-2411-03779.creator: Maciej Beręsewicz, Marek Wydmuch, Herman Cherniaiev, Robert Pater
arxiv-2411-03779.description: Abstract The goal of this paper is to develop a multilingual classifier and conditional probability estimator of occupation codes for online job advertisements in accordance with the International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO) extended with the Polish Classification of Occupations and Specializations (KZiS), which is analogous to the European Classification of Occupations.

arxiv-2505-21874.creator: Ruiguo Yu, Yiyang Zhang, Yuan Tian, Yujie Diao, Di Jin, Witold Pedrycz
arxiv-2505-21874.description: Abstract Medical image segmentation methods generally assume that the process from medical image to segmentation is unbiased, and use neural networks to establish conditional probability models to complete the segmentation task. This assumption does not consider confusion factors, which can affect medical images, such as complex anatomical variations and imaging modality limitations.

pmc-11355781.title: Historical and Contemporary Debates in Schlemm’s Canal-Based MIGS
pmc-11355781.creator: Etsuo Chihara, Teruhiko Hamanaka, Monica M Jablonski
pmc-11355781.description: Glaucoma is one of the primary causes of blindness worldwide. Canal opening surgery, a type of minimally invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) applied in cases of mild to moderate glaucoma, has gained increasing popularity in recent years due to its efficacy in reducing the intraocular pressure, its safety profile, the simplicity of its technique, and the reduced likelihood of compromised vision.

pmc-11402018.title: What is the impact of patient attributes, implant characteristics, surgical techniques, and placement location on the success of orthodontic mini-implants in young adults? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis☆
pmc-11402018.creator: Cristina Valeri, Angelo Aloisio, Giuseppe Marzo, Gianmarco Costigliola, Vincenzo Quinzi
pmc-11402018.description: BackgroundTemporary anchorage devices (TADs) address challenges in traditional orthodontic anchorage like patient compliance and precision, showing significantly improved clinical outcomes, particularly for cases requiring maximum anchorage.Materials and MethodsA systematic electronic search was performed in five research databases, focusing on studies published between 2015 and 2023. The ROBINS-I tool from the Cochrane Bias Methods Group assessed the risk of bias.

pmc-11431045.title: Genome-Wide Identification of the Rehmannia glutinosa miRNA Family and Exploration of Their Expression Characteristics Caused by the Replant Disease Formation-Related Principal Factor
pmc-11431045.creator: Li Gu, Yanlin Lai, Guojun Zhang, Yanhui Yang, Bao Zhang, Jianming Wang, Zhongyi Zhang, Mingjie Li, Qinghu Ma
pmc-11431045.description: Background/Objectives: Rehmannia glutinosa, a highly valuable medicinal plant in China, is encountering severe replant disease. Replant disease represents a complex stress driven by multiple principal factors (RDFs), including allelochemicals, microbes, and their interactions. miRNAs are recognized as key regulators of plant response to stresses; however, their specific roles within RDFs are not entirely clear.

pmc-11515776.title: Analysis of imaging features and clinical manifestations in children with congenital rib deformities: a retrospective study
pmc-11515776.creator: Shujun Ke, Jing Liu, Huiyong Hu, Xiuhua Duan, Haifa Hong, Li Shen
pmc-11515776.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCongenital rib deformity is a common thoracic deformity that has a potentially far-reaching impact on the growth and lung function development of young children. Early diagnosis and accurate assessment of congenital rib deformity is of great importance.

pmc-11584352.title: Mediating Effect of Illness Perception on the Relationship Between Perceived Family Function and Sleep Quality Among Patients With Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-11584352.creator: Xiaoqing Lu, Zifen An, Yuying Xu, Xi Zhang, Pei Fang, Yaping Lu, Zhongxiang Cai, Liping Yu
pmc-11584352.description: AimsTo evaluate the sleep quality of patients with atrial fibrillation and its influencing factors, and explore whether illness perception mediates the relationship between family function and sleep quality.DesignCross‐sectional survey conducted from November 2020 to November 2021.MethodsA total of 191 participants validly completed the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index, the Family APGAR Index and the Brief Illness Perception Questionnaire.

pmc-12457154.title: Case Report: A novel intronic variant of NIPBL gene detected in a child with cornelia de lange syndrome
pmc-12457154.creator: Xiao Ting Shao, Yu Xuan Dai, Yu Fang Zhao, Yu Hang Chen, Ling Jing Ying
pmc-12457154.description: BackgroundCornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) is a genetically heterogeneous disorder involving multi-system organs, causing physical and mental congenital malformation. Nipped-B-like protein (NIPBL) variants are associated with various CdLS phenotypes. Newborns with typical clinical manifestations (intellectual disability, special appearances, and limb malformation) require a diagnosis. However, diagnosing CdLS is challenging on account of its heterogeneity of genotype and phenotype.

pmc-13248962.title: Effects of Acoustic Environments on Well-Being in Sensory-Vulnerable Populations: A Systematic Review
pmc-13248962.creator: Jingyi Mu, Zhe Qin, Tian Wang
pmc-13248962.description: BackgroundAcoustic environments profoundly influence the well-being of sensory-vulnerable populations. This review aimed to systematically examine the effects of acoustic environments on the well-being of sensory-vulnerable populations across three domains: health, cognition, and emotion.MethodsThis review was reported based on the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between 2000 and 2025.

pmc-13420715.title: Late-Presenting Fulminant Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Myocarditis Managed With Abatacept and Venoarterial Extracorporeal Oxygenation
pmc-13420715.creator: Daniel S. Kikuchi, Edan Zitelny, Ashish Correa, Jonathan L. Halperin, Evan Leibner, Gregory W. Serrao, Gagan Sahni
pmc-13420715.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) myocarditis is an uncommon but potentially fatal cardiovascular immune-related adverse event that typically presents early after initiating immunotherapy.Case SummaryA 36-year-old man with colorectal cancer treated with pembrolizumab presented with cardiogenic shock after 460 days of immunotherapy. Ultimately, he was found to have ICI myocarditis by clinical and histopathological criteria.

pmc-13525931.title: Radiological response of primary central nervous system lymphoma after corticosteroid therapy and its predictive value on overall survival: a multicenter study
pmc-13525931.creator: Florian Scheichel, D. Pinggera, T. Rossmann, B. Popadic, S. Aspalter, V. Schön, A. Woehrer, M. M. Dorostkar, C. Dorfer, C. F. Freyschlag, F. Marhold
pmc-13525931.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPrimary Large-B-Cell Lymphoma of the CNS (PCNS-LBCL) is a rare, aggressive tumor often sensitive to corticosteroid therapy (CST). This multicenter study investigated the spectrum of radiological responses to routine CST and evaluated its impact on patient prognosis.MethodsThe researchers utilized a prospective cohort of 18 patients for volumetric MRI analysis and a combined prospective-retrospective cohort of 31 patients for 2D tumor analysis. Patients received CST post-biopsy, with follow-up MRIs performed on the seventh day (median) after surgery.
